Property.Name: mipi-sdca-entity-type
Property.Description: This Property shall contain the Entity Type for this Entity.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-entity-label
Property.Description: This Property shall contain the Label for this Entity.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-control-list
Property.Description: This Property shall indicate which of the 64 possible Control Selectors are present for this Entity. If this Entity does not implement any Controls, then the value of the bitmap shall be zero.

Package.Name: Sdca_ControlSelector
Package.Description: This Subproperty shall contain the name of the object that contains Subproperties for one Control Selector for this Entity.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-input-pin-list
Property.Description: This Property shall indicate which of the 64 possible input pins are connected for this Entity.

Package.Name: Sdca_Pinlist
Package.Description: This Subproperty shall reference the Entity Descriptor for the Entity connected to input pin n for this Entity.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-terminal-type
Property.Description: This Property shall indicate the Terminal Type for this IT.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-terminal-reference-number
Property.Description: This Property shall indicate the Reference Number of the External Peripheral Connection for this IT.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-terminal-connector-type
Property.Description: This Property shall indicate the Terminal Connector Type to which this IT is connected.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-terminal-transducer-count
Property.Description: This Property shall indicate how many Input Transducers are attached to this IT.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-terminal-pipe-number
Property.Description: This Property shall indicate the NDAI pipe number associated with this streaming IT.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-RxUMP-ownership-transition-max-delay
Property.Description: This Property shall contain the maximum time in microseconds allowed for this Device to change the ownership from Device to Host in an Rx UMP when Host Software is waiting for the owner to change back to Host.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-FDL-reset-mechanism
Property.Description: This Property shall indicate the reset mechanism that Host Software should use in response to an FDL Status of Request_Reset.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-cs-type
Property.Description: Indicates the type of Clock Source.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-clock-valid-max-delay
Property.Description: This Property shall indicate the maximum delay in microseconds that software needs to wait for clock to be valid for this Clock Source.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-powerdomain-managed-list
Property.Description: This Property shall be an array that indicates which Entities are explicitly managed by this PDE.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-powerdomain-transition-typical-delay
Property.Description: This Property shall be an array indicating the typical time in microseconds that this PDE will take to transition from one power state to another.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-powerdomain-transition-max-delay
Property.Description: This Property shall be an array indicating the maximum time in microseconds that this PDE will take to transition from one power state to another.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-ge-managed-terminal-reference-number
Property.Description: This Property shall contain the value of Property mipi-sdca-terminal-reference-number within the Entity Descriptors of the IT(s) and/or OT(s) managed by this GE.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-RxUMP-ownership-transition-max-delay
Property.Description: This Property shall indicate the maximum time in microseconds allowed for the Device to change the ownership from Device to Host in an Rx UMP for this SPE when Host Software is waiting for the owner to change back to Host.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-RxUMP-ownership-transition-max-delay
Property.Description: This Property shall indicate the maximum time in microseconds allowed for the Device to change the ownership from Device to Host in an Rx UMP for this MFPU when Host Software is waiting for the owner to change back to Host.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-smpu-trigger-ready-max-delay
Property.Description: This Property shall indicate the maximum time in microseconds that Host Software will wait for a trigger to be ready for this SMPU.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-smpu-empty-fifo-count
Property.Description: This Property shall indicate the latency in samples for this SMPU between the SMPU buffer and the Output Terminal, i.e., the number of samples that the Host should read after changing Hist_CurrentOwner back to Device before disabling the data port (to ensure Sample continuity between capture streams).

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-RxUMP-ownership-transition-max-delay
Property.Description: This Property shall indicate the maximum time in microseconds allowed for the Device to change the ownership from Device to Host in an Rx UMP for this SMPU when the Host Software is waiting for the owner to change back to Host.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-RxUMP-ownership-transition-max-delay
Property.Description: This Property shall indicate the maximum time in microseconds allowed for the Device to change the ownership from Device to Host in an Rx UMP for this SAPU when Host Software is waiting for the owner to change back to Host.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-tone-nominal-frequency
Property.Description: This Property shall indicate the base frequency in Hz for this TG.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-HIDTx-supported-report-ids
Property.Description: This Property shall be an array indicating which Reports could be transmitted by this HIDE Tx.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-HIDRx-supported-report-ids
Property.Description: This Property shall be an array indicating which Reports could be transmitted by this HIDE Rx.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-HIDTx-supported-feature-report-ids
Property.Description: This Property shall be an array indicating which Reports could be transmitted by this HIDE Tx.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-HIDRx-supported-feature-report-ids
Property.Description: This Property shall be an array indicating which Reports could be transmitted by this HIDE Rx.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-hide-related-audio-function-list
Property.Description: This Property shall be an array indicating which Audio Function Numbers within this Device are sending/receiving the messages in this HIDE.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-RxUMP-ownership-transition-max-delay
Property.Description: This Property shall indicate the maximum time in microseconds allowed for the Device to change the ownership from Device to Host in an Rx UMP for this HIDE when Host Software is waiting for the owner to change back to Host.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-clock-connection
Property.Description: This Subproperty shall contain the name of the object that contains the Entity Descriptor of the Clock Entity (either a Clock Source or a Clock Selector) that directly supplies the clock to this WCE.

BufferProperty.Description: This Buffer Property shall contain the name of the buffer that describes the relative location details for the microphones within the microphone array connected to this IT.
This Buffer Property shall contain the name of the buffer that describes the Sensitivity of the microphones within the microphone array connected to this IT.
This Buffer Property shall contain the name of the buffer that describes the Signal-to-Noise ratio of the microphones within the microphone array connected to this IT.
This Buffer Property shall contain the name of the buffer that describes the physical properties of the jack connected to this IT.

This Buffer Property shall be an array of SoundWire register addresses and the values that need to be written to each such register when channel(s) within the data port(s) associated with this IT are prepared for streaming. This Property shall only be declared for streaming ITs.

This Buffer Property shall be an array of SoundWire register addresses and the values that need to be written to each such register when channel(s) within the data port(s) associated with this IT are deprepared for streaming. This Property shall only be declared for streaming ITs.

This Buffer Property shall be an array of SoundWire register addresses and the values that need to be written to each such register when channel(s) within the data port(s) associated with this IT are enabled for streaming. This Property shall only be declared for streaming ITs.

This Buffer Property shall be an array of SoundWire register addresses and the values that need to be written to each such register when channel(s) within the data port(s) associated with this IT are disabled for streaming. This Property shall only be declared for streaming ITs.

This Buffer Property is a byte array describing the word width(s) of PCM on the Host that can be accepted (e.g., by the Host Agent) to produce PDM word widths that are supported as input to the Device Function. This Property should be present for every streaming IT that supports PDM streaming format(s), unless the PDM-PCM word length mapping is described elsewhere. Example: Buffer() { 0x01, 0x10, // 1 bit PDM -> 16 bit PCM 0x01, 0x20, // 1 bit PDM -> 32 bit PCM 0x02, 0x10, // 2 bit PDM -> 16 bit PCM 0x02, 0x18, // 2 bit PDM -> 24 bit PCM 0x02, 0x20 // 2 bit PDM -> 32 bit PCM }

This Buffer Property is a byte array describing the container size(s) (i.e., memory word width) of PCM on the Host that can be accepted (e.g., by the Host Agent) to produce various Stream word widths that are supported as input to the Device Function. Where the transport stream is PDM, the Host container size can be found for the corresponding PCM word width as described in the Terminal’s mipi-sdca-terminal-pdm-pcm-wordlength-configs-map. This Property should be present for every streaming IT that can be supplied by memory container sizes that differ from the configured Stream word width, unless that mapping is described elsewhere.

This Buffer Property shall contain the name of the buffer that lists each Control that will be affected when a particular mode is selected for this Group Entity. The contents of the named buffer shall have the following format: Buffer() { 0x03, // Mode Count (byte:1-n) 0x00, // Mode 0 (follows) 0x03, // Control Count 0x22, // Example of First Entity ID (byte) 0x00, // Example of First Control Selector (byte) 0x03, // Example of First Control Number (byte) 0x34, 0x12, 0x00, 0x00, // Example of First Control Value 0x1234 (4 bytes) ... // Entity ID (byte) ... // Control Selector (byte) ... // Control Number (byte) ... // Control Value (4 bytes) ... // Entity ID (byte) ... // Control Selector (byte) ... // Control Number (byte) ... // Control Value (4 bytes) 0x03, // Mode 3 (follows) 0x01, // Control Count ... // Entity ID (byte) ... // Control Selector (byte) ... // Control Number (byte) ... // Control Value (4 bytes) 0x11, // Mode 17 (follows) 0x01, // Control Count ... // Entity ID (byte) ... // Control Selector (byte) ... // Control Number (byte) ... // Control Value (4 bytes) }
